description: [devup-ui] Routing-first front door for Devup UI — a zero-runtime CSS-in-JS library whose Rust + WebAssembly preprocessor extracts every style at build time, so no styling JavaScript ships at runtime. Use to adopt/integrate Devup UI, wire the build-time plugin into Next.js/Vite/Rsbuild/Webpack/Bun, write styles with Box/css props or the styled-components-compatible styled() API, set up type-safe theming with devup.json, or migrate off styled-components/Emotion/Tailwind/Panda/vanilla-extract to zero runtime.
